BiblicalUsage: Ahishahar is named once, as the last son of Bilhan in the genealogy of Benjamin — seven brothers, one verse, no story attached to any of them.
TheologicalSignificance: A bare name is all the Bible gives me here, and I will not invent a lesson from it. The Chronicler kept the brothers together, and that is the whole of the record.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
